children: Salzgitter appointed Christoph Martin as its chief financial officer, succeeding  Birgit Potrafki, who is leaving to pursue a new career opportunity.
Martin will take the CFO role as of Oct. 1, with Potrafki assisting in the transition, the German steel company said.

Martin has been on the management board of Salzgitter Mannesmann Handel and Salzgitter Mannesmann International--two Salzgitter units--since January 2025. He began his career at Thyssenkrupp Steel Europe, where he held various controlling and finance positions.
